statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33634 is a supply-chain compromise of trivy release binaries v0.69.4 through v0.69.6, injected at build time via stolen Aqua credentials in March 2026. The malicious code was never committed to the trivy source tree. zot v2.1.17 depends on github.com/aquasecurity/trivy v0.70.0, which Aqua's post-incident disclosure confirms was rebuilt from clean main; the vulnerable code is not present in this version. The product PURL pins trivy v0.70.0; re-evaluate this statement if zot's go.mod moves trivy to a different version.
